items.title: A dualizing complex restricts to a dualizing complex under localisation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the localisation of a dualizing complex is again a dualizing complex over the localised ring (author lemma at source lines 2949-2955, label lemma-dualizing-localize). The proof (source lines 2957-2974) passes to a bounded injective representative, reads off finiteness of the cohomology from flatness, and verifies the duality axiom through the base change statement for internal homs (proof lines 2957-2973). The verification of the three axioms is the substance. H3.
